questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Polyethylene terephthalate, one of the most often recycled plastics and the material used in the majority of water and soda bottles, **__can be transformed__** into everything from polyester fabric to automotive parts.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "may be converted."
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The reason for selecting** "may be converted"** as the most appropriate option lies in the context of the sentence.
 
• The sentence is discussing the versatility of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) and how it can be transformed into various products.
 
• The word** "converted" **is suitable in this context because it accurately reflects the process of changing or transforming one form into another, which aligns with the idea of transforming PET into different products like polyester fabric and automotive parts. (इस संदर्भ में "परिवर्तित" शब्द उपयुक्त है क्योंकि यह एक रूप को दूसरे रूप में बदलने या बदलने की प्रक्रिया को सटीक रूप से दर्शाता है)
 
• Options like **"might be placed," "might be evolved," and "may be devaluated"** do not convey the intended meaning of transformation in this context.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence: *Polyethylene terephthalate, one of the most often recycled plastics and the material used in the majority of water and soda bottles, **may be converted**__ into everything from polyester fabric to automotive parts.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The deer was killed by the boar.

options.text: The boar was killing the deer.
The boar was killed by the deer.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"****The boar killed the deer."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. It is in Simple Past Tense.
 
• As per the given question, we must change it to Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
 
 
• In the passive voice, the action "killing" is performed by the doer "deer."
 
• "Boar" is the subject and "deer" is the object in the active voice.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

Correct sentence: *The boar killed the deer.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The secretary to my boss is very efficient as he not only gives him the required information **__and also handles__** correspondence independently.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "but also handles."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The given sentence has a small error in parallelism.
 
• **"Not only...but also"** is a correlative conjunction pair that is used to emphasize two related ideas or elements in a sentence. It helps to convey a sense of addition or inclusion.
 
• By adding **"but"** after **"not only,"** the sentence becomes grammatically correct and maintains a parallel structure.
 
• In this sentence, the speaker is emphasizing that the person mentioned possesses both musical talent and writing skills.
 
 
• **Example**: *The new software not only enhances productivity but also streamlines the workflow for better efficiency.*
 
 
 
• The structure** "not only...but also"** helps to highlight the dual qualities or characteristics.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.

Correct sentence: *The secretary to my boss is very efficient as he not only gives him the required information **but also handles**__ correspondence independently.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. My grandmother always went to school with me because the school was attached to the temple.

B. When we both finished, we would be back together.

C. While the children sat in rows on either side of the verandah singing the alphabet or prayer in chorus, my grandmother sat inside reading the scriptures.

D. The priest taught us the alphabet and the morning prayer.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "ADCB."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 

 
• The sequence of the sentences in the paragraph is arranged to create a coherent and logical flow of ideas.
 
 
• **Sentence A**: It introduces the reason why the grandmother went to school with the speaker, providing a personal connection to the narrative.
 
• **Sentence D**: It explains the priest's role in teaching the children the alphabet and the morning prayer, providing more details about the educational setting.
 
• **Sentence C**: It sets the scene by describing the environment of the school, where children are engaged in learning activities, and the grandmother is reading the scriptures inside.
 
• Sentence B: It concludes the paragraph by mentioning that after finishing their respective activities (grandmother reading scriptures, children learning from the priest), they would be back together.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

Correct sequence: 

A. My grandmother always went to school with me because the school was attached to the temple.

D. The priest taught us the alphabet and the morning prayer.

C. While the children sat in rows on either side of the verandah singing the alphabet or prayer in chorus, my grandmother sat inside reading the scriptures.

B. When we both finished, we would be back together.

questions.solution:

• **Example**: *The **cloud burst**__ unleashed a torrent of rain, and flooding the streets.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most suitable synonym for "cloud burst" in the given context is "rainstorm."
 
• A **rainstorm** involves heavy or prolonged rainfall, and it accurately captures the idea of a sudden release of a significant amount of rain as implied by the term** "cloud burst"** in the original sentence. (भारी या लंबे समय तक वर्षा)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The sudden **rainstorm**__ caught us by surprise during our picnic.*​
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

**Direction: Identify the option that can be substituted as the correct idiom for the underlined part of the given sentence.**

My cousin Neetu had an **__aerial view__** of the trade fair from the top of the giant wheel.

options.text: A bird in the gilded cage

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "****Bird’s eye view."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• An **"aerial view"** refers to a perspective or visual observation of something from above, typically from an elevated position, such as an aircraft, drone, satellite, or high vantage point. (ऊपर से किसी चीज़ का परिप्रेक्ष्य या दृश्य अवलोकन, आमतौर पर किसी ऊंचे स्थान से, जैसे कि विमान, ड्रोन, उपग्रह, या उच्च सुविधाजनक बिंदु)

 
 
• **Example**: *From the airplane window, I marveled at the breathtaking **aerial view**__ of the city below.*
 
 
 
• A** "bird's eye view" **refers to a perspective seen from above, as if you were looking down on something from the vantage point of a bird in flight. (ऊपर से देखा जाने वाला एक परिप्रेक्ष्य, जैसे कि आप उड़ते हुए पक्षी के सुविधाजनक बिंदु से नीचे किसी चीज़ को देख रहे हों)
 
• It provides a comprehensive and often detailed view of a scene, landscape, or object.
 __
 
• ​**Example**: *Standing on the observation deck, I enjoyed a **bird's eye view**__ of the entire cityscape below.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

(किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति का वर्णन करना जिसके पास भौतिक संपदा या विलासितापूर्ण परिवेश हो लेकिन वह किसी तरह से सीमित या प्रतिबंधित है, जिसमें अक्सर स्वतंत्रता या संतुष्टि का अभाव होता है)
 
• **Birds of same feather: **people who share similar interests, characteristics, or traits tend to associate with or befriend each other. (जो लोग समान रुचियों, विशेषताओं या गुणों को साझा करते हैं, वे एक-दूसरे के साथ जुड़ते हैं या मित्रता करते हैं)
 
• **Bird brain: **to playfully suggest that someone is not very intelligent or has a limited capacity for complex thinking. (खेल-खेल में यह सुझाव देना कि कोई व्यक्ति बहुत बुद्धिमान नहीं है या उसके पास जटिल सोच-विचार की सीमित क्षमता है)

questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. He later tried to franchise his restaurant.

B. Colonel Harland Sanders' real-life story of being disappointed numerous times in his life and still making his ambition come true late in life is truly motivating.

C. He began selling chicken at the age of 40, but his dream of opening a restaurant was repeatedly denied owing to conflicts and wars.

D. He is a seventh-grade dropout who tried many things in life but found them bitter.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "BDCA."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The sequence of the sentences is arranged to create a coherent and chronological flow of Colonel Harland Sanders' life story.
 
 
• **Sentence B** reflects on Colonel Sanders' story, emphasizing the motivational aspect of overcoming disappointments and achieving his ambition later in life.
 
• **Sentence D** introduces Colonel Sanders as a seventh-grade dropout who faced disappointments in various endeavors.
 
• Then, **sentence C** provides additional information about his life, mentioning that he began selling chicken at the age of 40 and faced repeated denials for his dream of opening a restaurant due to conflicts and wars.
 
• Finally, **sentence A** follows up by mentioning his attempt to franchise his restaurant, providing a continuation of his journey.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.

**Correct sequence:**

**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

We are organising the charity function tomorrow.

options.text: The charity function is been organised tomorrow.
The charity function is being organised tomorrow.
The charity function is being organise tomorrow.
The charity function is organised tomorrow.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"****The charity function is being organised tomorrow****."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Present Continuous Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + v1 + ing+ object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha is singing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song is being sung by Esha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'We.'​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'Charity function.' 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• **'I****s** organising' will be changed into 'is being organised.' 
 
• "Charity function" is a singular noun so we must "is" with it.
 
• The correct answer is option 2.
